entrees.description_source: In Settings, you can change the app appearance by choosing a base theme, adjusting accent, background, and foreground colors, and changing the UI and code fonts. You can also share your custom theme with friends.
entrees.usage: In **Settings**, you can change the app appearance by choosing a base theme, adjusting accent, background, and foreground colors, and changing the UI and code fonts. You can also share your custom theme with friends.

entrees.description_source: The Archived chats section lists archived chats with dates and project context. Use Unarchive to restore a chat.
entrees.usage: The **Archived chats** section lists archived chats with dates and project context. Use **Unarchive** to restore a chat.

entrees.description_source: Use these settings to install or enable the bundled Browser plugin, set up the browser extension, and manage allowed and blocked websites. ChatGPT asks before using a website unless you've allowed it. Removing a blocked site lets ChatGPT ask again before using it in the browser.
entrees.usage: Use these settings to install or enable the bundled Browser plugin, set up the [browser extension](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/chrome-extension), and manage allowed and blocked websites. ChatGPT asks before using a website unless you've allowed it. Removing a blocked site lets ChatGPT ask again before using it in the browser.

entrees.description_source: Check your Computer Use settings to review desktop-app access and related preferences after setup. On macOS, revoke system-level access by updating Screen Recording or Accessibility permissions in macOS Privacy & Security settings.
entrees.usage: Check your Computer Use settings to review desktop-app access and related preferences after setup. On macOS, revoke system-level access by updating Screen Recording or Accessibility permissions in macOS Privacy & Security settings.

entrees.description_source: Require Cmd+Enter for multiline prompts, or turn on Prevent sleep while running so local chats can continue while you step away. Under Follow-up behavior, choose whether a message sent while ChatGPT works should steer the current run or wait for the next run.
entrees.usage: Require <kbd>Cmd</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> for multiline prompts, or turn on **Prevent sleep while running** so local chats can continue while you step away. Under **Follow-up behavior**, choose whether a message sent while ChatGPT works should steer the current run or wait for the next run.

entrees.nom: Réglages : Keep a chat near your work
entrees.description_source: In the ChatGPT desktop app, pop out an active chat into a separate window and place it next to your browser, editor, or design preview. Turn on Always on top when you want the chat to remain visible while you work in another app.
entrees.usage: In the ChatGPT desktop app, pop out an active chat into a separate window and place it next to your browser, editor, or design preview. Turn on **Always on top** when you want the chat to remain visible while you work in another app.

entrees.description_source: Open Keyboard Shortcuts to review commands, change bindings, or reset custom shortcuts to their defaults. Use the search field to find shortcuts by command name, or switch to keystroke search and press a key combination to find the command that uses it.
entrees.usage: Open **Keyboard Shortcuts** to review commands, change bindings, or reset custom shortcuts to their defaults. Use the search field to find shortcuts by command name, or switch to keystroke search and press a key combination to find the command that uses it.

entrees.description_source: Enable Memories, where available, to let ChatGPT carry useful context from past chats into future work. See Memories for setup, storage, and controls for individual chats.
entrees.usage: Enable Memories, where available, to let ChatGPT carry useful context from past chats into future work. See [Memories](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/customization/memories) for setup, storage, and controls for individual chats.

entrees.description_source: Choose when turn completion notifications appear, and whether the app should prompt for notification permissions.
entrees.usage: Choose when turn completion notifications appear, and whether the app should prompt for notification permissions.

entrees.description_source: Choose Friendly, Pragmatic, or None as your default personality. Use None to disable personality instructions. You can update this at any time.

Pets are optional animated companions for the app. In Settings > Pets, choose a built-in or custom pet, then use /pet, Show pet, or Hide pet to control the floating overlay. Choose Mini to keep the chat controls visible without a pet.

Use Profile to review activity insights, lifetime tokens, peak tokens, streaks, your longest task, and token activity. You can also update your profile details, such as your picture, display name, and username, and save a profile card with usage highlights. Sharing profile cards is available on consumer ChatGPT plans.
entrees.usage: Use **Profile** to review activity insights, lifetime tokens, peak tokens, streaks, your longest task, and token activity. You can also update your profile details, such as your picture, display name, and username, and save a profile card with usage highlights. Sharing profile cards is available on consumer ChatGPT plans.

entrees.description_source: Use context-aware suggestions to surface follow-ups and tasks you may want to resume when you start or return to ChatGPT.
entrees.usage: Use context-aware suggestions to surface follow-ups and tasks you may want to resume when you start or return to ChatGPT.

entrees.description_source: Type : table. Multi-agent settings and custom role declarations. Scalar setting names are reserved and can't be used as custom role names.
Type : string. Default model for spawned agents. An explicit spawn model takes precedence.
Type : string. Default reasoning effort for spawned agents. An explicit spawn effort takes precedence.
Type : boolean. Enable or disable multi-agent tools (default: true).
Type : boolean. Record a model-visible message when an agent turn is interrupted (default: true).
Type : number. Maximum number of spawned-agent threads that can be open concurrently, excluding the primary thread. When unset, Codex chooses the default.
Type : number. Legacy alias for agents.max_concurrent_threads_per_session.
Type : string (path). Path to a TOML config layer for that role; relative paths resolve from the config file that declares the role.
Type : string. Role guidance shown to Codex when choosing and spawning that agent type.
Type : boolean. Allow shell-based tools to use login-shell semantics. Defaults to true; when false, login = true requests are rejected and omitted login defaults to non-login shells.

Type : on-request | never | { granular = { sandbox_approval = bool, rules = bool, mcp_elicitations = bool, request_permissions = bool, skill_approval = bool } }. Controls when Codex pauses for approval before executing commands. You can also use approval_policy = { granular = { ... } } to allow or auto-reject specific prompt categories while keeping other prompts interactive. untrusted is unsupported, and on-failure is deprecated; use on-request for interactive runs or never for non-interactive runs.
Type : boolean. When true, MCP elicitation prompts are allowed to surface instead of being auto-rejected.
Type : boolean. When true, prompts from the request_permissions tool are allowed to surface.
Type : boolean. When true, approvals triggered by execpolicy prompt rules are allowed to surface.
Type : boolean. When true, sandbox escalation approval prompts are allowed to surface.
Type : boolean. When true, skill-script approval prompts are allowed to surface.

Type : user | auto_review. Who reviews eligible approval prompts under on-request or granular approval policies. Defaults to user; auto_review uses the reviewer subagent. This setting doesn't change sandboxing or review actions already allowed inside the sandbox.
Type : user | auto_review. Default reviewer for app tool approval prompts unless overridden per app. When omitted, apps inherit the top-level approvals_reviewer value.
Type : auto | prompt | writes | approve. Default approval behavior for app tools without per-app or per-tool overrides.
Type : boolean. Default allow/deny for app tools with destructive_hint = true.
Type : boolean. Default app enabled state for all apps unless overridden per app.
Type : boolean. Default allow/deny for app tools with open_world_hint = true.
Type : user | auto_review. Reviewer for this app's tool approval prompts. Overrides apps._default.approvals_reviewer.
Type : auto | prompt | writes | approve. Default approval behavior for tools in this app unless a per-tool override exists.
Type : boolean. Default enabled state for tools in this app unless a per-tool override exists.
Type : boolean. Allow or block tools in this app that advertise destructive_hint = true.
Type : boolean. Enable or disable a specific app/connector by id (default: true).
Type : boolean. Allow or block tools in this app that advertise open_world_hint = true.
Type : auto | prompt | writes | approve. Per-tool approval behavior override for a single app tool.
Type : boolean. Per-tool enabled override for an app tool (for example repos/list).
Type : string. Local Markdown policy instructions for automatic review. Managed guardian_policy_config takes precedence. Blank values are ignored.
Type : number. Maximum poll window in milliseconds for empty write_stdin polls (background terminal polling). Default: 300000 (5 minutes). Replaces the older background_terminal_timeout key.
Type : boolean. Set to false to restrict browser-history access. Managed requirements can enforce this restriction.
Type : table. Fallback browser-origin restrictions. Supports access, uploads, downloads, and full_cdp_access, each set to allow or deny.

Type : table. Per-origin browser restrictions with the same fields as browser_use.default_origin_policy. Include an HTTP or HTTPS scheme and optional port; omit paths, queries, and fragments. Local values cannot relax managed denies.
Type : string. Override the base URL used during the ChatGPT login flow.
Type : boolean. Check for Codex updates on startup (set to false only when updates are centrally managed).
Type : file | keyring | auto | ephemeral. Control where the CLI stores cached credentials.

Interrupt runs when you interrupt an active turn on the main thread. Use it to record the interruption or clean up work started by a hook. It doesn't run for idle threads or subagents, and any configured matcher is ignored.
entrees.usage: { "systemMessage": "Saved the interrupted turn to the local audit log." }

entrees.description_source: PermissionRequest runs when Codex is about to ask for approval, such as a shell escalation or managed-network approval. It can allow the request, deny the request, or decline to decide and let the normal approval prompt continue. It doesn't run for commands that don't need approval.
PostCompact runs after Codex compacts the chat. matcher is applied to trigger, whose values are manual and auto.

PostToolUse runs after supported tools produce output, including Bash, apply_patch, MCP tool calls, and other local function tools. For Bash, it also runs after commands that exit with a non-zero status. It can't undo side effects from a tool that already ran. See Tool coverage for the supported paths and exceptions.
PreCompact runs before Codex compacts the chat. matcher is applied to trigger, whose values are manual and auto.
PreToolUse can intercept Bash, file edits performed through apply_patch, MCP tool calls, and other local function tools. See Tool coverage for the supported paths and exceptions.

SessionEnd lets you run a command when a session ends, such as saving final notes or cleaning up files. It runs for the main thread when you archive or delete a conversation that's still open, when Codex closes normally, or after a conversation has been idle and isn't open in any connected client for 30 minutes. It won't run for subagents.

Unset — Development only: Set the path to the Codex CLI executable. You don't need this setting unless you're developing the Codex CLI; manually overriding the bundled executable can prevent parts of the extension from working.
true — Show CodeLens above TODO comments so Codex can address them.
enter — Choose whether Enter always sends (enter), Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends multiline prompts (cmdIfMultiline), or the modifier is always required (cmdAlways).

queue — Choose whether messages sent during a run wait for the next run (queue) or steer the current run (steer). The extension treats the legacy interrupt value as steer. Press Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Enter to invert the behavior for one message.

inline — Run /review in the current chat when possible (inline) or start a separate review chat (detached).

Type : integer. Optional global fixed port for the local HTTP callback server used during MCP OAuth login. A server-specific oauth.callback_port takes precedence. When neither is set, Codex binds to an ephemeral port chosen by the OS.

Type : string. Optional base callback URL for MCP OAuth login, such as a devbox ingress URL. Newly added pre-registered clients use this URL unchanged when the authorization server supports issuer identification; existing clients without a saved callback append a server-specific callback ID. Without issuer support, any pre-registered MCP server whose configured callback lacks the required ID falls back to this URL with the ID appended. Callback URL ports don't select the listener port.

Type : oauth | chatgpt. Authentication fallback for an MCP HTTP server after configured bearer tokens and authorization headers. oauth (default) uses stored MCP OAuth credentials when available. chatgpt uses the current ChatGPT session for the trusted first-party ChatGPT origin, then falls back to stored OAuth. Both modes can connect without authentication if no credential source resolves.
